---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a resource, community program, documentation improvement, or repository feature
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ""
---

## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the gap, confusion, or opportunity. Focus on the problem before the solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like DevSphere to add or change?

## Who benefits?

- [ ] New developers
- [ ] Experienced developers
- [ ] Students
- [ ] Open-source contributors
- [ ] Community moderators or maintainers
- [ ] Other:

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why are they less suitable?

## Scope and maintenance

- Is this a one-time addition or an ongoing commitment?
- Does it require a paid service, API key, or new dependency?
- Who could help maintain it?

## Additional context

Add links, examples, or mockups. Do not include credentials or private data.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and discussions.
- [ ] This request is free to implement and maintain, or I have explained any cost.
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/Sumit-tech01/DevSphere-Community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have read the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/Sumit-tech01/DevSphere-Community/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
